title: Ask the AI clinical agent
summary: By voice: ask about the patient of the selected appointment (summary, allergies, the last thing done, what's due today) and dictate the session or the odontogram.

steps.title: Menu → My Workspace
steps.details: The doctor's view: their schedule and the clinical panel of the patient they're seeing.

steps.title: Choose the patient's appointment
steps.details: Tap the appointment on the schedule: the patient panel opens on the right. If you don't see appointments, change the day or the period at the top.

steps.title: Turn on Voice and talk to it
steps.details: With the appointment selected, the voice card shows “Clinical case: …”: what you ask is about that patient and the clinical agent answers it, knowing the appointment and the history. Ask “give me a summary”, “does she have any allergies?” or “what did we do last time?”, or dictate the session (“I did a cleaning and a filling on 16, next visit a check-up”): it prepares it and asks whether to save it or review it. It also marks the odontogram. “Close the case” stops talking about that patient; “back to the case” resumes it.
